column1: # tools/suite-map.tsv — the changed-path -> suite map. THE MAP IS THE GATE.
# Format: <glob pattern><TAB><space-separated suites covering it>. Rows are ADDITIVE: name EVERY suite
# that covers a file. Lines starting with # are comments. `!` rows are exemptions (files with no suite)
# — add one only with a reason. `~` rows are PENDING suites: declared, arriving with a sibling branch
# (fleet/a11y); while the suite file is absent, selecting it SKIPS with 'fast-gate: pending:' instead
# of failing, and once it lands it runs like any other suite. A PLAIN row naming a missing suite is a
# stale map and fails the gate. Every suite in the tree must be reachable from a row (`~` counts) or
# exempted with `!`, or the gate fails loudly (reverse check).
# The SW/offline suite covers the PWA surface (it verifies sw caching + manifest contents in dist).
# Suite self-rows: the reverse check (every tree suite reachable from the map) reads these.
# Same suites at the singular test/ spelling from fleet/a11y's earlier tips; inert unless they exist.
# Static assets and prose carry no behaviour; no suite covers them.
